steps.name: Hover tooltip
steps.expect: Hover tooltip appears with identifying text.

steps.name: Tooltip essentials
steps.expect: Shows species name and exhibit/essentials (likelihood line may appear).

steps.name: More Info
steps.do: Click **More Info** (or equivalent) from the tooltip.

steps.name: Amenity or pavilion tooltip
steps.do: Enable **Restaurants** or **Pavilions**; click a non-animal marker.

steps.name: Dismiss tooltip
steps.do: Click empty map or dismiss control.

steps.name: Replace tooltip
steps.expect: Tooltip content switches cleanly to the new target.

steps.name: Hover after click
steps.do: Hover a different marker after dismissing click tooltip.
